integrity: The standalone verifier performs exhaustive finite exact rational tests; the asymptotic assertions rely on the analytic proof and a standard hypergeometric central limit theorem, not on finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The exact conditional law assumes fair symmetric steps and a bridge at exactly 2n; the n=k boundary is degenerate. General ordered-length formulas are known, making priority for the explicit finite law qualified. The joint n^(1/4) microscopic limit and correlation rate are the assessed structural conclusions; no claim about biased or non-nearest-neighbor walks.
title: Hypergeometric short excursions and a Rayleigh–Gaussian two-scale limit for random-walk bridges
